title: Pyne Pod Strawberry Kiwi Ice Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pyne Pod NicSalts Strawberry Kiwi Ice 10ml E-Liquid offers a brilliantly balanced fruit profile with a cooling twist. The inhale is defined by the soft, jammy sweetness of ripe Strawberries, which blends effortlessly with the slightly acidic, exotic tang of Kiwi. To ensure a crisp finish, a brisk layer of Ice is introduced on the exhale, providing a clean, frosty contrast. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Pyne Pod Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Pyne Pod Nic Salts collection translates the intense, highly popular flavours of their renowned prefilled pods into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the cooling fruit notes of Strawberry Kiwi Ice, vapers can explore other irresistible blends such as the tart Lemon Lime, the rich Strawberry Cherry, or the cooling Pomegranate Ice.
